description: Complete package workflows for the canonical engine's Duplex.fromWeb/toWeb bridge. Run scripts/project_compat_runner.py --corpus fixtures/compatibility/projects/stream-duplex.corpus.json --bin target/release/franken-node --node node --bun bun --artifacts-dir /tmp/franken-stream-duplex-001. Reference-only tests are not native runtime or npm/Bun parity evidence.

cases.description: A CommonJS package exports a Web transform; the Node pipeline adapts both sides and writes exact JSONL output.
A conditional ESM package's Node transform is adapted into a Web pipeline; async sink close writes a separately checked completion file.

files.main.mjs: import {make} from '@fixture/transform';import {Duplex} from 'node:stream';import {ReadableStream,WritableStream} from 'node:stream/web';import fs from 'node:fs';const t=make();ReadableStream.from([20,21]).pipeThrough(Duplex.toWeb(t)).pipeTo(new WritableStream({write(value){fs.appendFileSync('result.txt',value+'\n');},async close(){await Promise.resolve();fs.writeFileSync('complete.txt','closed\n');}})).then(()=>console.log('DUPLEX_ESM_COMPLETE',t.writableFinished));

cases.description: A dependency adapts its Node transform to a Web pair and back; ordinary Node build output is not collected by the adapter.
A package's two Web endpoint cleanup callbacks write durable evidence before the adapted Duplex close event reports completion.
An ESM dependency returns a Web identity transform; Duplex decoding preserves a Unicode scalar split over three byte chunks before file output.

files.main.mjs: import {make} from './endpoint.mjs';import {Readable,Duplex} from 'node:stream';import {pipeline} from 'node:stream/promises';import fs from 'node:fs';const pieces=[new Uint8Array([226]),new Uint8Array([130]),new Uint8Array([172,33,10])];pipeline(Readable.from(pieces),Duplex.fromWeb(make(),{encoding:'utf8',highWaterMark:1}),fs.createWriteStream('result.txt')).then(()=>console.log('DUPLEX_UTF8_COMPLETE'));
files.endpoint.mjs: import {TransformStream} from 'node:stream/web';export function make(){return new TransformStream();}
